answer: Proof of Agent deters Sybil swarms by binding each identity to bonded collateral in a vault and correlating signed messages, timing, and stake provenance. If k identities equivocate in concert, penalties scale as O(k^2), exhausting shared collateral faster than linear growth. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies, making a coordinated grove or terrace of aliases economically irrational despite asymmetric depreciation.
